status: fixed repeated launch-visible drift patterns; low-risk one-off drift documented

issues.currentPattern: Central admin loading/cached/unavailable badges used sky/cyan/slate accent colors outside the documented launch palette.
issues.expectedPattern: Use the brand purple or neutral gray status palette through the shared admin status badge.
issues.launchImpact: Admin modules could look like unrelated systems and make status badges scan inconsistently.
issues.suggestedFix: Map loading/cached to brand purple and unavailable to neutral gray; add launch badge containment to the shared badge.

issues.driftType: badge containment and static chip affordance
issues.currentPattern: Drop card badges and file chips had local sizing/overflow behavior and static chips could inherit button-like visual affordance.
issues.expectedPattern: Reusable launch badge containment for all pills; static chips must not behave or read as controls.
issues.launchImpact: Long labels or file-count chips could overflow compact cards and create fake interactive controls.
issues.suggestedFix: Use LAUNCH_BADGE_CONTAINMENT_CLASSNAME on badge/timer pills and LAUNCH_STATIC_BADGE_CLASSNAME on non-interactive chips.

issues.driftType: badge containment and modal chip consistency
issues.currentPattern: Preview modal timer/file badges duplicated pill containment locally instead of sharing the launch badge contract.
issues.expectedPattern: Modal badges use the same containment and static-chip helpers as drop grid cards.
issues.launchImpact: Preview modal badges could wrap differently from grid cards on mobile.
issues.suggestedFix: Apply launch badge containment to modal timer and static badge helpers to the file-count badge.

issues.currentPattern: Chart accent, axis, grid, legend, and tooltip colors were defined inline in the chart component.
issues.expectedPattern: Admin charts read from a documented KandyDrops chart color token map.
issues.launchImpact: Future chart modules could drift into random color palettes and inconsistent contrast.
issues.suggestedFix: Move chart colors to KANDYDROPS_CHART_COLORS and consume them from the chart component.

issues.currentPattern: Starter SVG files exist in public but are not referenced by launch UI, manifest, PWA, or 404 surfaces.
issues.expectedPattern: Launch UI may not reference obsolete starter logos/icons; unused files can be deleted in a later cleanup.
issues.launchImpact: No visible launch impact while references remain absent.
issues.suggestedFix: Keep validator coverage for references; delete unused starter files in a separate asset cleanup if desired.

issues.currentPattern: The filter bar uses a local -mx-1 edge-bleed treatment.
issues.expectedPattern: Shell and launch route containers must not rely on negative margin safe-area fixes; small component edge bleed is documented if bounded.
issues.launchImpact: No launch shell overlap was detected; this remains a localized filter affordance.
issues.suggestedFix: Do not broaden this pass; only revisit if the mobile shell audit flags overflow or overlap.

issues.component: admin support and AI detail surfaces
issues.currentPattern: Several non-launch-primary admin detail surfaces still contain local cyan/blue utility accents.
issues.expectedPattern: Repeated status, card, and chart primitives should use shared tokens; one-off detail accents need a later component-by-component review.
issues.launchImpact: Lower priority than central badge and chart drift because these are not the shared launch primitives changed in this pass.
issues.suggestedFix: Move any repeated post-launch admin detail chips into shared primitives instead of replacing every one-off accent now.

issues.currentPattern: Drop countdown logic already renders final 24h as HH:MM:SS without monospace timer classes.
issues.expectedPattern: More than 24h keeps Ends in copy; final 24h shows countdown-only text using inherited site font.
issues.launchImpact: Compliant; validator locks the prior timer fix so design drift cannot reintroduce bulky copy or terminal typography.
issues.suggestedFix: Keep static validation for countdown-only final-day labels and absence of font-mono in timer components.
